children: Fervo Energy signed a 396 MW, 15-year power purchase agreement with Google for an enhanced geothermal project, with an option to expand to nearly 950 MW by June 2030.
Entered a 15-year PPA to sell 396 MW from a Cape Station EGS project delivered in four 99 MW tranches, starting Q3 2028.
Fervo and Alphabet each provided parent company guaranties supporting subsidiary obligations under the PPA.
Offered Google a capacity expansion option of ~600 MW, bringing potential contracted capacity to ~950 MW subject to acceptance and agreement.
Expansion must meet SB 132 regulatory approvals; expanded delivery capability targeted for H1 2030 if authorized.
If Fervo fails to offer required expansion, it must reimburse Google for certain deemed-delivered energy payments, amount not yet estimable.
